description: This file defines the UserRepository interface in Java, extending JpaRepository for User entities. It provides methods for finding a User by email and checking for existence by email, acting as a data access object for user persistence.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Interface extending JpaRepository for User entities, providing methods for querying users by email and checking existence.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User by email, returning an Optional containing the User if found.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks whether a User exists with the specified email.
